title: Acquired, Then Divested: Whose Data Governance Applies Now
scenario_text: Aurland Learning (an education-technology provider) must determine which entity owns a district's student records after a chain of transactions. "Skjold Learning Labs, Inc." (EIN 27-8890034) was acquired by "Aurland Learning Holdings" in 2022-06, becoming a wholly owned subsidiary and integrating into Aurland's identity and data-processing systems (records migrated into Aurland's tenant T-AUR-9). In 2024-03, Aurland divested Skjold in a stock sale to "Framnes Education Group" (EIN 61-2204871); Skjold Learning Labs, Inc. retained its own EIN 27-8890034 and its customer contracts, and the stock-purchase agreement transferred 100% of Skjold's shares to Framnes along with a data-transition plan requiring Skjold's student data to move to Framnes's tenant by 2024-09. A support ticket now asks Aurland to export and delete a school district's student records held under Skjold's contracts. Aurland's systems still contain the migrated data in tenant T-AUR-9, but as of the 2024-03 divestiture Skjold is no longer an Aurland subsidiary. The district's data-processing agreement (DPA) names "Skjold Learning Labs, Inc." as the processor. The stock sale did not dissolve Skjold; it changed Skjold's owner from Aurland to Framnes. An analyst assumes Aurland remains the data controller because the bytes still sit in Aurland's tenant. The district expects a response within its DPA's 30-day window, so Aurland must correctly identify the responsible processor before it acts on the export-and-delete request.
question: Which entity is now the responsible data processor for the district's student records, and what should Aurland do?
choices: Aurland Learning Holdings remains the responsible processor because the records physically reside in Aurland's tenant T-AUR-9.

Skjold Learning Labs, Inc. (EIN 27-8890034), now owned by Framnes Education Group, is the responsible processor under the district DPA; Aurland must transition the data out per the transition plan and cease processing as a former parent.
Framnes Education Group (EIN 61-2204871) is directly named in the district DPA and is therefore the processor of record.
No entity is responsible because the divestiture voided the original data-processing agreement.
